semantics.parent_rule: Each hour atom belongs to one exact weekly interval.
semantics.duration_rule: Minimum canonical subdivision is one hour.
semantics.project_rule: Hour atom may reference exact Project participation/work evidence.
semantics.split_rule: Sub-week evidence may be represented by multiple hour atoms.
semantics.conservation_rule: Hour subdivision cannot create more represented time than the original accepted work evidence.
semantics.aggregation_rule: Hour atoms aggregate deterministically to weekly interval.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
